useCase: Detecting hidden information, compression irregularities, and AI生成的 JPEG 异常
mechanism: 分析 the 分布 of quantized DCT 系数 using chi-square statistics. Expected 分布s follow predictable 模式 for natural images; deviations indicate 篡改, AI generation, or hidden data embedding.
accuracy: Medium - 72-83% for detecting compression 异常 and AI 伪影
name: 卡方分析
parameters: 块大小: 8x8 DCT, Test: chi-square goodness-of-fit, Significance: p < 0.05, Coefficients: AC components
description: 应用 chi-square 统计 test to DCT 系数 分布s 以检测 steganographic embedding and compression 异常 common in AI outputs.

references.title: Westfeld, A. & Pfitzmann, A. (2000). Attacks on Steganographic Systems. Information Hiding.
Fridrich, J. et al. (2003). Detection of Double-Compression in JPEG Images. Information Hiding.

strengths:
• Well-established 统计 framework
• 检测 both steganography and AI 伪影
• Fast computation on DCT 系数
• Quantifiable p-value for confidence
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG compressed images
• Sensitive to image quality and size
• High compression can mask 异常
• Limited effectiveness on PNG/WebP formats
